intent.summary: A simple annular disc intended to be placed under a fastener (bolt/nut) to distribute load, prevent surface damage, or provide spacing.
implied: Being a washer implies an annular (ring) shape with a central through-hole.
Being a washer implies it is used with a fastener (bolt/screw/nut) to spread clamping load or protect a surface.
unstated: Inner diameter / bolt size the washer must fit
Material (steel, stainless, brass, nylon, etc.) and its mechanical properties
Load or clamping force / torque the washer must withstand
Flat washer vs. lock washer vs. spring/belleville washer type
Applicable standard (e.g., ISO 7089, DIN 125, ANSI B18.22.1) if standardization is required
Any hardness or surface flatness requirement
risk_signals: No indication of application context (e.g., structural, pressure-bearing, vehicle, lifting) is given, so risk level cannot be assessed from the brief alone.

requirements.statement: The washer shall be round about its axis (equally wide in every direction in the XY plane).
requirements.rationale: A washer is a disc; its outer profile must be circular, not merely have equal bounding-box extents.

requirements.statement: The washer shall have a central through-hole (bore) of 10.5 mm diameter, sized to clear an M10 fastener.
requirements.rationale: No bolt size was given; M10 is a common generic fastener size and ISO 7089 gives 10.5 mm as the standard clearance bore for M10.

requirements.statement: The washer shall have an outer diameter of 20 mm.
requirements.rationale: 20 mm is the standard ISO 7089 outer diameter for an M10 flat washer, consistent with the assumed bore.

requirements.statement: The washer shall have a uniform thickness of 2 mm.
requirements.rationale: 2 mm is the standard ISO 7089 thickness for an M10 flat washer.

requirements.statement: The washer shall have exactly one central through-hole (the bore).
requirements.rationale: A washer is defined by a single central clearance hole for the fastener shank.

assumptions.statement: The washer is sized to fit an M10 fastener, giving a 10.5 mm clearance bore.
assumptions.rationale: The brief gives no bolt size or application; M10 is a commonly used generic fastener size for a demonstration washer.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: If a different fastener size is intended, the bore, outer diameter and thickness all need to be re-derived and the part remade.

assumptions.statement: The washer follows ISO 7089 standard proportions for M10: 20 mm outer diameter, 2 mm thickness.
assumptions.rationale: In the absence of stated outer diameter or thickness, the matching ISO flat-washer standard gives a defensible, commonly manufactured size.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: A washer of the wrong outer diameter or thickness may not fit the intended joint or provide the intended bearing area.

assumptions.statement: The washer is a plain flat washer, not a lock washer, spring washer or Belleville washer.
assumptions.rationale: The brief says only "washer" with no mention of locking or spring function; flat is the most generic and common type.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: A locking or spring function would require a fundamentally different geometry (split ring, dished profile, serrations) that this flat disc does not provide.

assumptions.statement: The washer is made of plain carbon steel, a typical material for a generic hardware washer.
assumptions.rationale: No material, load, or environment was specified; plain steel is the conventional default for an unspecified generic washer.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: If a corrosive environment or higher load were intended, a different material (stainless steel, nylon, hardened steel) and possibly different dimensions would be required.

document.description: A flat annular washer with a central clearance bore, sized per the accepted assumptions for an M10 fastener (ISO 7089 proportions).
